responsibility: Supplies PowerPC 476-specific target hook overrides for the rs6000 port. In particular it redirects the generic target macros that control link-stack preservation and end-of-assembly handling to rs6000 helpers used for this core, enabling 476-specific handling of the hardware link stack and final assembler emission behavior in conjunction with the matching option support.
same_name_distinction: This is the 476 target-configuration header in the 476 group: it overrides rs6000 target macros and hooks such as TARGET_LINK_STACK and TARGET_ASM_CODE_END. Unlike 476.md, it does not describe instruction scheduling, and unlike 476.opt, it does not declare the user option itself.
